start.title: Junior Astronaut
start.subtitle: 30 days on the Moon
start.story: You are the commander of Moon base "Tranquility" in the Sea of Tranquility. Every game day is a real day of space weather from the NASA archive (April 17 – May 16, 2024).
start.noSafe: There is no safe choice: what you take from one place, you lose in another.

week.title: Week {week} complete
week.earned: Patch earned! Keep it up, commander!
week.notEarned: Goal not reached, but the mission goes on.
week.goal1: at the end of the week, battery ≥ 8 and life support ≥ 70.
week.goal2: collect ≥ 60 science in the week and have a full battery (12) on day 14.
week.goal3: life support must never drop below 50.
week.goal4: radiation dose must grow by no more than 20 in the week.
week.best: Best result: +{dose}. Can you beat it?

evac.title: Crew evacuated
evac.text: Mission Control decided to evacuate the crew. Real commanders sometimes return early too: safety comes first. Try a different plan!
